channel.title: Observability Market Reports -- Michal Bojko
channel.description: Bi-weekly observability market updates and quarterly reports. Data-driven insights on platform engineering and SRE practices.

item.title: Earnings Prove It, Agents Ship It: The Autonomy Race Hits Escape Velocity (July 28 - August 9, 2026)
item.description:
Earnings season proved the market is healthy, a wave of agentic product releases proved every vendor is racing to the same destination, and the security-meets-observability thesis got a second wind at Black Hat.

Key stories: Datadog Q2 2026 revenue $1.12B, up 36%, guidance raised. Dynatrace Q1 FY2027 revenue $554.55M, ARR $2.14B, CFO to retire. Grafana Labs ships six tools during inaugural AI Week. Dynatrace launches Autonomous SRE Agent and Cloud SRE Agent. Cribl debuts AI Observability App at Black Hat. Elastic expands OpenAI partnership, stock rises 12%.

Read the full update

item.title: Palo Alto Doubles Down, Gartner Names Six Leaders (July 14 - July 27, 2026)
item.description:
Two forces ran in parallel: the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Observability Platforms and a more consequential piece of market structure news, Palo Alto Networks announcing its intent to acquire Embrace.

Key stories: Palo Alto Networks to acquire Embrace (RUM and Synthetics), combined Chronosphere business crosses $300M ARR. 2026 Gartner MQ names six Leaders: Datadog, Grafana Labs, Dynatrace, Elastic, Chronosphere, IBM. Elastic earns AWS AI Security Distinction. Splunk Enterprise Security 8.6.0 enters Controlled Availability with AI-powered detection workflows.

Read the full update

item.title: Agentic Ops, Government Push, Elastic's Counter-Move (June 23 - July 13, 2026)
item.description:
Strategic convergence: multiple vendors moved simultaneously to own agentic AI operations and regulated government markets.

Key stories: Datadog acquires Adaptive ML (RLOps, AI Research division). New Relic Autopilot autonomous SRE agent and Ground Truth API layer targeting GA late July. Dynatrace and New Relic both announce FedRAMP High commitments in the same week. Elastic cuts 7%, CPO exits, launches Prometheus migration tools targeting Datadog and Grafana customers. Bernstein downgrades Datadog to Market Perform. Dynatrace board refreshed under Starboard Value pressure.

Read the full update

item.title: Autonomous Ops Race, Splunk Crisis, AI Code Paradox (June 9-22, 2026)
item.description:
The first two weeks of June drew a sharp line between vendors building toward an autonomous, AI-native future and those scrambling to hold their ground.

Key stories: Datadog DASH 2026 with 100+ new capabilities repositioning Bits AI as a fully autonomous operations layer. New Relic SRE Agent and no-code Agentic Platform. Splunk CVE-2026-20253 (CVSS 9.8) actively exploited, CISA KEV listed. Dynatrace: AI workloads drove 93% increase in log volume, 45% of observability budgets consumed by log management (~$2.5M/year/enterprise).
